title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Closed Stacks. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Closed Stacks
options.lineage: library card catalogues and reading-room card indexes
options.thesis: One index, two readers: you walk the drawers, agents read the same cards.
options.viewport: The cabinet at night: drawer labels as navigation, one card on the desk, the latest ten fanned from the open drawer.
options.risk: Repro-stalgia: typed cards read as cosplay unless the marks carry real state.

raised.raise: The cabinet sits in one continuous field of light, with no section boxes or panel chrome anywhere.
Motion is one mechanical step that overshoots and settles; nothing glides, nothing fades in.
State is a mark, never a hue: new, updated, and today are grease-pencil marks in the single accent.

options.label: Plates and Declinations
options.lineage: observatory plate atlases and long-exposure sky surveys
options.thesis: The corpus as a measured sky: every note a dated plate, every wikilink a real constellation line.
options.viewport: A single exposed plate: navigation rides ruled catalogue columns, entries are dated like observations.
options.risk: Dark ground with fine light marks is a familiar cosmic look, and it only earns its place if the stars carry real dates and neighbours rather than decoration.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.lineage: museum accession ledgers and custody records
options.thesis: Every note shows its custody: what is known, what is inferred, and who wrote it.
options.viewport: One ribbon column down the page, dated folds in ledger serif, tracing a note's life.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: provenance is already this product's word (origin, promote, previous) and known-versus-inferred type maps honestly onto human and agent authorship; the buff ground is the one material conflict, translated onto the pinned black.
options.risk: Archival red on buff reads institutional, and the ribbon can become ornament instead of the chain it describes.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: pocket airline timetables and tinted glass slides
options.thesis: One type size for the whole site; rank is carried by weight, case and rule alone.
options.viewport: A raked rack of slides along one bed, a tick rail showing position, each slide restating its own heading.
options.case: Fuses cleanly onto the list surfaces: the rack is the archive, the tick rail answers long log runs, and a single type size is a real discipline for a text-first site; the lit bed becomes one raking light on black.
options.risk: Goldenrod fights the pinned palette, and one type size goes flat without iron rules for rank.

options.label: Two-Ink One-Sheet
options.thesis: The whole site printed in two inks, with the shadow carrying the hierarchy.
options.viewport: A title set like a charge being read out, a small figure, a long shadow, and a ruled billing block at the foot.
options.case: Fuses on identification: it is the most cinematic hand dealt and the closest to a monochrome editorial at full commitment; the shadow-as-navigation device is where it fails clarity.
options.risk: Shadow-led navigation is theatre rather than wayfinding, and the cream stock clashes with the pinned canvas.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: stage lighting plots and cyclorama washes
options.thesis: Atmosphere organised as horizon bands, from depthless black through cobalt and rose to white day.
options.viewport: Stacked horizon bands of light with the content held inside them, cue names in lighting-plot stencil caps.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Content rides stacked cloth courses that step under one fixed window, one size of condensed caps throughout.
options.viewport: A roll of cloth courses stepping under one window, a punched tape edge as the index.
options.kept: Motion as one snapped course that overshoots and settles.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.lineage: film cutting benches and work prints
options.thesis: One ink on true black, rank by cell count, and state carried entirely by marks.
options.viewport: A perforated rail crossing the sheet, frames strung along it, set-aside frames hanging below on pins.
options.kept: State as a mark, not a hue.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a personal engineering blog ships: a centred column on light paper, one reading serif, sans metadata, one link blue.
canonCard.viewport: A centred column, a dated post list, an about paragraph at the top.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
